init.title: Bus alert settings

data.home_zone: Home location (a zone — edit it under Settings → Areas, labels & zones)
data.alert_mode: When should "Time to leave" turn on?
data.drive_minutes: Travel time from home to the stop (minutes, used by the minutes-based alert)
data.buffer_minutes: Extra buffer (minutes, used by the minutes-based alert)

init.description: Distance is the most reliable choice: watch a run or two and set the alert distance to how far out the bus is when you need to leave. The minutes estimate is a straight-line guess and runs early on routes with lots of stops. "Time to leave" stays off after the bus reaches your stop.

options.distance: When the bus is within the alert distance (recommended)
options.time: When the minutes estimate is within travel time + buffer
